env GO111MODULE=off
[short] skip

# Set up fresh GOCACHE.
env GOCACHE=$WORK/gocache
mkdir $GOCACHE

# Building a main package should run the compiler and linker ...
go build -o $devnull -x main.go
stderr '(compile|gccgo)( |\.exe).*main\.go'
stderr '(link|gccgo)( |\.exe)'

# ... and a second build finds both in the cache ...
go build -o $devnull -x main.go
! stderr '(compile|gccgo)( |\.exe).*main\.go'
! stderr '(link|gccgo)( |\.exe)'

# ... a named output is copied out of the cache ...
go build -o main$GOEXE -x main.go
! stderr '(link|gccgo)( |\.exe)'
stderr 'cp .*main'

# ... and an output that is up to date is left alone.
go build -o main$GOEXE -x main.go
! stderr '(link|gccgo)( |\.exe)'
! stderr 'cp .*main'

-- main.go --
package main
func main() {}
